verdict.rationale: Circle's docs describe registrable outbound webhooks: Circle sends an HTTP POST to an endpoint you configure when a resource changes state. The Gateway API has endpoints to manage webhook subscriptions, and CPN notifications are signed with a fetchable public key for verification. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog and delivery/retry semantics, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: When a resource changes state, Circle sends an HTTP POST to the endpoint you configure so your application can react.
Manage webhook subscriptions for Gateway event notifications.
Verify each notification's signature before you trust it.
